page.overview:
What is laurinquë?

Laurinquë was one of the Fragrant Trees brought by the Elves from Tol Eressëa to Númenor. These trees grew in abundance in the province Hyarrostar. Laurinquë had long-hanging yellow flowers and was falsely rumored to be descended from Laurelin.

The name Laurinquë consists of the Quenya terms laure ("gold") and possibly -inqua, an adjectival ending.
